evidence.excerpt: columns: 과목, 제46기, 제45기, 제44기; unit: 백만원; row: 연구개발비용 계 (원재료비+인건비+감가상각비+위탁용역비+기타); values: 23,938 / 22,135 / 18,052 (제46/45/44기)

notes: Total R&D cost by nature of expense (원재료비, 인건비, 감가상각비, 위탁용역비, 기타), company-wide, not product-level -- Hanmi does not disclose R&D spend by product or tool type anywhere read for this packet. The same table shows this total is booked 판매비와관리비 19,396/17,855/15,860 and 제조경비(manufacturing expense) 4,542/4,280/2,192 (제46/45/44기); the SG&A portion is separately registered under rd_expense (HANMI-RDEXP-{year}, matching the main income statement's own 연구와개발비용 line exactly) and the manufacturing-expense portion is HELD -- no existing metric fits a manufacturing-expense-booked R&D sub-line and one was not minted for this intake (see handback report).

evidence.excerpt: columns: 과목, 제46기, 제45기, 제44기; unit: 백만원; row: 연구개발비 / 매출액 비율 [연구개발비용계÷당기매출액×100]; values: 4.3% / 4.0% / 11.5% (제46/45/44기)

notes: Issuer-computed ratio, not atlas-derived: Hanmi's own footnote states "'연구개발비 / 매출액 비율'은 별도 재무제표상 매출액을 기준으로 산출하였습니다" (computed on SEPARATE, not consolidated, financial-statement revenue -- see HANMI-REV-SEPARATE-{year} for that denominator).
